ValidationRule.description: Only DD/COE can apply Discount to Deployment SKU (TAN-ESR-DEPLMT-EE)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISCHANGED ( SBQQ__Discount__c ), (ISNEW() && SBQQ__Discount__c >0) ), SBQQ__ProductCode__c == 'TAN-ESR-DEPLMT-EE', $User.ProfileId <> '00e60000001FUqR'
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: No additional discount can be applied to ESR Deployment Services without prior approval. If an accredited partner can not support the implementation, please email eso@tanium.com for ESR pricing approval. If approved, contact COE to discount.
